prompt_fingerprint_note: Stamped retroactively. The prompt text was verified byte-identical to the committed agent before the fingerprint was computed, so this hash describes the run that produced these scores.

results.question: How many orders are there in total?
results.gold_sql: select count(*) as orders from olist_marts.fct_orders
results.agent_sql: SELECT count(order_id) AS total_orders FROM olist_marts.fct_orders LIMIT 200

results.question: How many distinct customers are there?
results.gold_sql: select count(distinct customer_unique_id) as customers from olist_marts.fct_orders
results.agent_sql: SELECT count(DISTINCT customer_unique_id) AS distinct_customers FROM olist_marts.dim_customers LIMIT 200

results.question: What are the RFM segments?
results.gold_sql: select distinct rfm_segment from olist_marts.fct_segment_aspect order by rfm_segment
results.agent_sql: SELECT DISTINCT rfm_segment FROM olist_marts.fct_segment_aspect ORDER BY rfm_segment LIMIT 200

results.question: How many orders does each segment have?
results.gold_sql: select distinct rfm_segment, orders_in_segment from olist_marts.fct_segment_aspect order by rfm_segment
results.note: orders_in_segment is segment-level; a plain select repeats it 16 times
results.agent_sql: SELECT DISTINCT rfm_segment, orders_in_segment FROM olist_marts.fct_segment_aspect ORDER BY orders_in_segment DESC LIMIT 200

results.question: What percentage of each segment's orders have review text?
results.gold_sql: select distinct rfm_segment, review_text_coverage_pct from olist_marts.fct_segment_aspect order by rfm_segment
results.agent_sql: SELECT DISTINCT rfm_segment, review_text_coverage_pct FROM olist_marts.fct_segment_aspect ORDER BY rfm_segment LIMIT 200

results.question: Which aspect is mentioned in the most orders overall?
results.gold_sql: select aspect, sum(orders_mentioning_aspect) as total from olist_marts.fct_segment_aspect group by aspect order by total desc limit 1
results.agent_sql: SELECT aspect, sum(orders_mentioning_aspect) AS total_orders_mentioning FROM olist_marts.fct_segment_aspect GROUP BY aspect ORDER BY total_orders_mentioning DESC LIMIT 1

results.question: List the five most mentioned aspects with their totals.
results.gold_sql: select aspect, sum(orders_mentioning_aspect) as total from olist_marts.fct_segment_aspect group by aspect order by total desc limit 5
results.agent_sql: SELECT aspect, sum(orders_mentioning_aspect) AS total_mentions FROM olist_marts.fct_segment_aspect GROUP BY aspect ORDER BY total_mentions DESC LIMIT 5

results.question: Which segment has the highest delivery complaint rate among reviewed orders?
results.gold_sql: select rfm_segment, sum(case when is_delivery_complaint then aspect_rate_of_reviewed else 0 end) as rate from olist_marts.fct_segment_aspect group by rfm_segment order by rate desc limit 1
results.note: must use is_delivery_complaint, and the reviewed denominator
results.agent_sql: SELECT rfm_segment, sum(CASE WHEN is_delivery_complaint THEN aspect_rate_of_reviewed ELSE 0 END) AS delivery_complaint_rate_among_reviewed FROM olist_marts.fct_segment_aspect GROUP BY rfm_segment ORDER BY delivery_complaint_rate_among_reviewed DESC LIMIT 1

results.question: How many customers are in the champions segment?
results.gold_sql: select distinct customers_in_segment from olist_marts.fct_segment_aspect where rfm_segment = 'champions'
results.agent_sql: SELECT DISTINCT rfm_segment, customers_in_segment FROM olist_marts.fct_segment_aspect WHERE rfm_segment = 'champions' LIMIT 200

results.question: What is the average order value?
results.gold_sql: select avg(order_value) as avg_order_value from olist_marts.fct_orders
results.agent_sql: SELECT avg(order_value) AS avg_order_value FROM olist_marts.fct_orders LIMIT 200

results.question: What is the total revenue across all orders?
results.gold_sql: select sum(order_value) as revenue from olist_marts.fct_orders
results.agent_sql: SELECT sum(order_value) AS total_revenue FROM olist_marts.fct_orders LIMIT 200

results.question: How many orders were delivered?
results.gold_sql: select count(*) as delivered from olist_marts.fct_orders where order_status = 'delivered'
results.agent_sql: SELECT count(order_id) AS delivered_orders FROM olist_marts.fct_orders WHERE order_status = 'delivered' LIMIT 200

results.question: How many orders are there per order status?
results.gold_sql: select order_status, count(*) as orders from olist_marts.fct_orders group by order_status order by orders desc
results.agent_sql: SELECT order_status, count(*) AS order_count FROM olist_marts.fct_orders GROUP BY order_status ORDER BY order_count DESC LIMIT 200

results.question: What is the average delivery time in days for delivered orders?
results.gold_sql: select avg(delivery_days) as avg_days from olist_marts.fct_orders where order_status = 'delivered' and delivery_days is not null
results.agent_sql: SELECT avg(delivery_days) AS avg_delivery_days FROM olist_marts.fct_orders WHERE order_status = 'delivered' AND NOT delivery_days IS NULL LIMIT 200

results.question: Which aspects belong to the fulfilment group?
results.gold_sql: select distinct aspect from olist_marts.fct_segment_aspect where aspect_group = 'fulfilment' order by aspect
results.agent_sql: SELECT DISTINCT aspect FROM olist_marts.fct_segment_aspect WHERE aspect_group = 'fulfilment' LIMIT 200

results.question: How many aspects count as delivery complaints?
results.gold_sql: select count(distinct aspect) as n from olist_marts.fct_segment_aspect where is_delivery_complaint
results.agent_sql: SELECT count(DISTINCT aspect) AS delivery_complaint_aspect_count FROM olist_marts.fct_segment_aspect WHERE is_delivery_complaint LIMIT 200

results.question: For the hibernating segment, list aspects by their rate among reviewed orders, highest first.
results.gold_sql: select aspect, aspect_rate_of_reviewed from olist_marts.fct_segment_aspect where rfm_segment = 'hibernating' order by aspect_rate_of_reviewed desc
results.agent_sql: SELECT aspect, aspect_rate_of_reviewed FROM olist_marts.fct_segment_aspect WHERE rfm_segment = 'hibernating' ORDER BY aspect_rate_of_reviewed DESC LIMIT 200

results.question: Which prompt version and model produced the aspect labels?
results.gold_sql: select distinct label_prompt_version, label_model from olist_marts.fct_segment_aspect
results.agent_sql: SELECT DISTINCT label_prompt_version, label_model FROM olist_marts.fct_segment_aspect LIMIT 200

results.question: How many orders mention product_quality in each segment?
results.gold_sql: select rfm_segment, orders_mentioning_aspect from olist_marts.fct_segment_aspect where aspect = 'product_quality' order by rfm_segment
results.agent_sql: SELECT rfm_segment, sum(orders_mentioning_aspect) AS total_orders_mentioning_quality FROM olist_marts.fct_segment_aspect WHERE aspect = 'product_quality' GROUP BY rfm_segment ORDER BY total_orders_mentioning_quality DESC LIMIT 200

results.question: What is the highest order value?
results.gold_sql: select max(order_value) as max_value from olist_marts.fct_orders
results.agent_sql: SELECT MAX(order_value) FROM olist_marts.fct_orders LIMIT 200

results.question: How many orders have more than one seller?
results.gold_sql: select count(*) as multi_seller from olist_marts.fct_orders where seller_count > 1
results.agent_sql: SELECT count(*) AS orders_with_multiple_sellers FROM olist_marts.fct_orders WHERE seller_count > 1 LIMIT 200

results.question: Compare the champions and hibernating segments on their delivery complaint rate among reviewed orders.
results.gold_sql: select rfm_segment, sum(case when is_delivery_complaint then aspect_rate_of_reviewed else 0 end) as rate from olist_marts.fct_segment_aspect where rfm_segment in ('champions', 'hibernating') group by rfm_segment order by rfm_segment
results.agent_sql: SELECT rfm_segment, MAX(review_text_coverage_pct) AS review_coverage_pct, sum(CASE WHEN is_delivery_complaint THEN aspect_rate_of_reviewed ELSE 0 END) AS delivery_complaint_rate_among_reviewed FROM olist_marts.fct_segment_aspect WHERE rfm_segment IN ('champions', 'hibernating') GROUP BY rfm_segment LIMIT 200

results.question: How many customers are in each state?
results.gold_sql: select customer_state, count(*) as customers from olist_marts.dim_customers where is_current group by customer_state order by customers desc
results.note: dim_customers is SCD2; a count without is_current double-counts changed customers
results.agent_sql: SELECT customer_state, count(DISTINCT customer_unique_id) AS customer_count FROM olist_marts.dim_customers WHERE is_current = TRUE GROUP BY customer_state ORDER BY customer_count DESC LIMIT 200

results.question: How many product categories are there?
results.gold_sql: select count(distinct product_category) as categories from olist_marts.dim_products
results.note: the column is product_category, not product_category_name; --validate-gold caught it
results.agent_sql: SELECT count(DISTINCT product_category) AS category_count FROM olist_marts.dim_products LIMIT 200

results.question: Which segment has the lowest review text coverage?
results.gold_sql: select rfm_segment, max(review_text_coverage_pct) as coverage from olist_marts.fct_segment_aspect group by rfm_segment order by coverage asc limit 1
results.agent_sql: SELECT rfm_segment, MAX(review_text_coverage_pct) AS review_text_coverage_pct FROM olist_marts.fct_segment_aspect GROUP BY rfm_segment ORDER BY review_text_coverage_pct ASC LIMIT 1
